question: Should OpenClaw adopt the bundled modular-dashboard architecture and its stream/computed binding contract as a core-shipped plugin surface?
rationale: The PR extends an unmerged dashboard program with a bundled plugin, persistent workspace model, agent tools, and security-sensitive browser data paths; code review cannot infer product sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor the dashboard stack
options.body: Approve the architecture direction, land the foundation bottom-up, and require the remaining contract, storage, security, and proof fixes before this feature merges.

options.title: Move it outside core
options.body: Keep the dashboard as an external plugin and separately propose only genuinely missing Plugin SDK seams.

options.title: Pause the program
options.body: Defer or close the cumulative stack until product ownership and maintenance are established.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the dashboard stack
recommendation.body: Approve the architecture direction, land the foundation bottom-up, and require the remaining contract, storage, security, and proof fixes before this feature merges.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history and CODEOWNERS make `steipete` the strongest adjacent owner for the bundled Control UI/plugin direction.
